description: A painting of a man in a dark peaked cap and long coat leaning out of the side of a wooden horse-drawn wagon, reaching to put a letter into a wooden roadside mailbox with a red flag on a post. A brown horse in harness stands at the left. The wagon's side has painted letters reading 'U.S. MAIL'. Behind is a dirt lane curving past fields under a stormy sky, with a farmhouse and barn in the distance. Dim, warm oil-painting palette, edge to edge with no frame.
reason: The wagon's side has the painted lettering 'U.S. MAIL' (and a faint additional word above it). Remove or repaint the lettering so the wagon side is blank.
